newsitem.title: USA: US jet fuel slides on NYMEX drop, diffs unchanged.
newsitem.headline: US jet fuel slides on NYMEX drop, diffs unchanged.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices slipped lower on the sudden selloff in NYMEX prices late Friday, with little change noted in differentials.
NYMEX heating oil prices ended more than one cent lower on the day on what traders described as "position squaring" ahead of the short Thanksgiving holiday week.
Market players said few barrels appeared to change hands Friday, with U.S. Gulf Coast prompt 54-grade barrels talked between 1.15 amd 1.40 cents below the NYMEX print
Ample supply of material remained on offer, one trader said, though few serious buyers were noted in the market.
